We are looking for an experienced developer who can create a live sports and live casino platform with advanced user management capabilities. The platform should have a super admin, admin, master, agent, and user roles for effective management and control.

We welcome white label solution providers who can offer customized solutions that meet our unique requirements. Additionally, we prefer ready-made solutions that can be tailored to fit our needs.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop a robust and scalable live sports and live casino platform with advanced user management capabilities
Implement a multi-level user management system with super admin, admin, master, agent, and user roles
Customize the platform to meet our unique requirements while maintaining its user management features
Perform comprehensive testing to ensure the platform is stable and user-friendly
Provide ongoing technical support and maintenance, with a focus on user management and control.
Requirements:

Proven experience in developing live sports and live casino platforms with advanced user management capabilities
Strong knowledge of user management systems and role-based access control
Proficiency in programming languages such as PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL and MongoDB
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work, with a focus on user management and control.
If you are an experienced developer with expertise in creating live sports and casino platforms with advanced user management capabilities, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

job_post:
Project / operations manager for content and editorial

We are a content marketing company focused on the editorial and publishing side, and specialize in high-tech niches. We’re now looking for a part or full-time, reliable project/operations manager t to help us manage our project pipelines, our team and clients, and manage and optimize our internal processes so we can continue to grow our company, keep things moving, and provide the best products and services for our clients. 

We have very high standards and are looking for someone who is an awesome team player with a fantastic attitude in all situations, who wants to work in a very collaborative and fast-paced and dynamic environment, can learn quickly with minimal oversight, is highly competent, and can keep up for the long run!  

This is a variable role, and you will work alongside the business owner and team members daily to help get everyone and everything in order so things get done – done right and done on time. 

 We work Monday-Friday, CET business hours, but with flexibility.


Your responsibilities include:


Content project management


Work with our content strategist to assign content briefs to writers 
Work with our content strategist to monitor our client content calendars and that we are always on schedule
Assign content to edit to our editors
Ensure writers and editors meet their deadlines
Ensure content is published on time 
Create and monitor spreadsheets to track and manage content to-do items 
Understand all project requirements and check all work for task compliance
Ensure social media management is completed in a timely way
Monitor social media calendar submissions, post creation and submission, and follow through the process until completion

Operations management 

Add/ remove Slack members
Update account passwords
Conduct data and file backups
Onboard new team members to our processes
Set up Trello boards and Slack channels 
Find innovative and creative ways to improve our workflows and processes
Set up access to WordPress backends 
Manage access to Google files
Manage company files in Google drive
Work with the managing director and accountant to create team and project budgets
Work to optimize resources 
Create process documentation and train others as needed


Communications management

Oversee and manage Slack, Trello, and email communications with team members and clients
Attend client meetings
Coordinate communications and relay critical information among team members and with clients


Technical skills

Project management: Trello, Smartsheets, and Jira 
Communications: Slack 
Design: Figma and Canva
Website / content management: WordPress 
File creation and management: Google Suite & Microsoft excel/ Google sheets (you should be a spreadsheet wizard) 
Familiarity with marketing automation tools
Familiarity with SEO analytics tools like Google and Ahrefs 
Analytical/ mathematical / financial skills
Good understanding of and interest in IT or other high-tech topics
Strong understanding of content marketing and marketing communications


Soft skills

Communication: near Native English skills with excellent business and web writing skills
Professionalism: adherence to deadlines, following through, finishing out daily tasks, prompt response to urgent tasks, etc.
Empathetic: understands that everything we do is for others and can understand things from other people's perspectives
Communicative: open and honest with your communications; specify your needs and wants; are not afraid to speak up for yourself; communicate about challenges and ideas; ask for clarification and guidance when you are unsure or need help
Independent with the ability and willingness to research and learn new things when you don't know how to do something; you never say “I can't do that” without trying first
Ability to teach and guide others to successfully perform their jobs (bonus if you have experience as a teacher) 
Dedicated, committed, and loyal – you are in it for the long term and want to be part of the success of the company 
Agile and proactive – you can wear multiple hats and juggle multiple tasks with ease
Energetic and full of endurance
Stable and reliable 
Exceptional attention to detail and organizational abilities
A natural problem solver and strategist with great situational awareness

We have a pretty fast-paced team that touches base every day and we would love someone that can fit right in and make this role their own. 

If you are in it to win it, please apply!

Skills: Trello, Microsoft Excel, Team Management, Task Creation, Budget Management, Project Timelines, Digital Project Management, Project Management, Tech & IT

job_post:
PHP/MySQL Developer for ongoing WordPress Development

Greetings!

I have a WordPress theme which needs some enhancements now, on immediate basis, and then we are going to keep improving the theme based on user feedbacks on an ongoing basis. \

For now, here are the improvements needed:

1. Update WooCommerce template files.
2. Ensure that a unique prefix is used for all function names, classes, hooks, public/global variables, action/filter hooks, custom image sizes, constants, database entries, theme-specific scripts and theme-specific styles to avoid conflicts with plugins and other themes.
3. Use ’-’ instead of ’_’ or ’.’ for handlers and remove any extension such as “min”, “css” or “js"
4. Remove unused code fragments (ie commented out code), todo lists in comments, or any other comments that do not contribute to understanding the code.
5. Make sure you properly prepare the data for $wpdb.
6. $_POST, $_GET, $_REQUEST data needs to be sanitized.
7. Mention WPDB in your response to confirm you read the requirements.
8. Check that all AJAX requests are using a nonce, for example: wp_create_nonce('any_value_here');

If you are interested in this project, please let me know what you need to provide me with a quotation or if you would prefer to work on an hourly basis. 

Thank you

Skills: PHP, MySQL, WordPress, JavaScript
